in_sanskrit.name: भूपेश
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: भूर्भुवस्स्वाह - The one who protects the Earth and the Universe

in_marathi.name: Bhupesh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Earth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhupesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bhupesh is a Sanskrit and Hindu name that means 'Lord of the Earth'. This name is derived from two Sanskrit words: Bhuh (earth) and Ish (lord). Bhupesh is a powerful and strong name that symbolizes loyalty and stability. It is a name for those who are in positions of authority and rule.
